map.总鼻部症状评分（Total Nasal Symptom Score, TNSS）: The Total Nasal Symptom Score (TNSS) quantifies the severity of allergic or chronic rhinitis: rhinorrhoea, sneezing, nasal itching and nasal obstruction are each scored 0-3 for a total of 0-12. It helps you track symptom changes before and after medication or immunotherapy. Results are for self-observation only and do not replace an ENT diagnosis.
map.四项鼻部症状（流涕、喷嚏、鼻痒、鼻塞）各 0–3 分自评: Self-assess the four nasal symptoms (rhinorrhoea, sneezing, itching, obstruction) at 0-3 each
map.自动累加总分（0–12），直观反映整体严重程度: Automatically sums the total (0-12) to show overall severity at a glance
map.逐症状记录，便于发现最困扰的单项: Records each symptom separately so the most troublesome one stands out
map.支持治疗前后对比，观察症状变化: Supports before-and-after comparison to observe symptom change
map.纯前端运行，数据不上传: Runs purely in the front end, nothing uploaded
map.过敏性鼻炎（花粉、尘螨等）季节性发作的自我记录: Self-recording of seasonal allergic rhinitis attacks (pollen, dust mites and so on)
map.慢性鼻炎患者日常症状觉察: Daily symptom awareness for chronic rhinitis patients
map.用药或脱敏治疗前后的疗效对比: Comparing treatment response before and after medication or immunotherapy
map.就诊前整理症状，方便向医生说明: Organising symptoms before a visit so you can explain them to the doctor
map.：0 无；1 极少，偶尔擤鼻；2 经常，需频繁擤鼻；3 持续，量大: : 0 none; 1 very occasional, rare nose-blowing; 2 frequent, needs repeated nose-blowing; 3 continuous and heavy
map.：0 无；1 散发性；2 阵发性（数次）；3 频繁阵发性（>10 次/轮）: : 0 none; 1 occasional; 2 in bouts (several); 3 frequent bouts (more than 10 per bout)
map.：0 无；1 偶发；2 明显、可忍；3 持续难忍: : 0 none; 1 occasional; 2 obvious but tolerable; 3 persistent and hard to bear
map.：0 通畅；1 轻度，夜间偶发；2 中度，常需口呼吸；3 重度，持续口呼吸: : 0 clear; 1 mild, occasional at night; 2 moderate, often needs mouth breathing; 3 severe, continuous mouth breathing
map.静坐后回忆当天整体鼻部感受，逐项打分。: Sit quietly, recall how your nose felt overall that day, and score each item.
map.四项分数相加得到 TNSS 总分（0–12）。: Add the four scores to get the TNSS total (0-12).
map.记录日期，便于形成症状日记。: Record the date to build a symptom diary.
map.治疗干预后隔几天再评一次，对比前后总分与单项变化。: Re-assess a few days after the intervention and compare the total and individual scores.
map.固定每天同一时段评分（如睡前），减少波动干扰。: Score at a fixed time each day, such as before bed, to reduce fluctuation.
map.关注单项而非只看总分：若鼻塞单项长期偏高，可能合并结构性因素（如鼻息肉、偏曲）。: Watch individual items rather than only the total: a persistently high obstruction score may signal a structural factor such as polyps or a deviated septum.
map.总分持续 ≥8 或严重影响睡眠，建议耳鼻喉科就诊。: A total persistently at or above 8, or sleep being clearly affected, warrants an ENT visit.
map.花粉季可结合当地花粉预报，观察分数与暴露的关系。: During pollen season, combine local pollen forecasts to observe the relation between scores and exposure.
map.不能。它只是症状量化自评，确诊还需结合鼻内镜、皮肤点刺或血清特异性 IgE 等检: No. It is only a quantified symptom self-assessment; confirmation also needs nasal endoscopy, skin prick testing or serum specific IgE, judged by a doctor.
map.四项各 0–3 分、总分 0–12；单项 3 为最重，总分通常超过 8 分提示症: Each of the four items is 0-3 for a total of 0-12. A score of 3 on one item is the most severe, and a total above 8 usually indicates notable symptoms; if it keeps affecting daily life, seek care.
map.怎么用 TNSS 观察疗效？: How do I use TNSS to monitor treatment response?
map.用药或脱敏治疗前、后各评一次，对比总分与单项变化；分数下降说明缓解，上升提示控制: Score once before and once after medication or immunotherapy and compare the total and individual scores. A falling score indicates improvement, while a rising one suggests poor control.
